Volume is fading hard: 1.08M, 579k, 244k, then 63k. Each push higher came on less participation, so the last bar's high of 100.67 is not confirmed. Overhead supply is dense: yesterday's 101.48 high, and the daily closes of 100.72 and 100.61 on 18-19 Nov were rejection zone. The 5-day return is -2.1%, so the trend is down. Daily ATR is 2.63, so the stock reverses violently.

I don't see a clean short either. Four rising closes and a +0.53% index argue against fading blindly.

Verdict: stay out of the long. Short only on a failure: trigger below 99.85 (the 09:40 close, after a rejection at 100.72), stop 100.80, target 98.50 (about 1.35 of reward against 0.95 of risk). Marginal at best.
